This pass is a second look at the location only. The first agent asked for it. Research nothing but the three location fields, and write the shard to a new path so the first shard is kept.

- Genesee County power station (L100001083333): The current point is about 54 kilometers from the Thetford site named in the filing. The new point is a cleared vacant pad beside the Thetford 345 kV substation, picked from satellite imagery. The filing names the site and the substation but gives no address.
  The first agent wrote: Status stays pre-construction. The project is still moving through the plan review, so Latest Activity is left alone. No link to a specific data center was found. The old Thetford plant is EIA plant 1719 with nine retired units, a different set of units. A Midcontinent Independent System Operator queue entry J3935 for 975.4 megawatts at the Thetford point is a lead only and is not cited.
- Milan Township power station (L100001088928): The current point is in the town of Milan. Figure 2 of the testimony shows the site just east of US 23, with a quarry to the east, the Dundee engine plant to the south and Azalia to the north. The new point is the large field matching that figure. It was placed by eye from satellite imagery, not by a parcel.
  The first agent wrote: Status stays pre-construction. Latest Activity is left alone because the project is moving. The testimony names Midcontinent Independent System Operator requests J4024 and J4025, 1,499 megawatts each, for the Monroe County sites. They are to be studied in 2026.
